autostartKind.description: Our uniform auto-start mechanism per platform. Never the app's native enable path. 'manual' declares an app no script can start automatically; the gap is surfaced via list/verify.

hostAutostartEntry.description: Host-specific auto-start configuration with platform reference

autostartRuntimeEntry.description: Auto-start runtime configuration for one host

bundleId.description: macOS bundle identifier (e.g. com.if.Amphetamine). Used to locate the app for macos-launchagent manipulation.

autostartEnabled.description: Do we launch this app via our uniform auto-start mechanism. Required unless kind is 'manual', which nothing launches.

approvalInstructions.description: Manual approval steps shown when a macos-system-extension is not yet approved. Overrides the generic Privacy & Security hint because extension types differ (FSKit file-system extension vs TCC grants). Required for kind 'macos-system-extension' and 'manual'.

path.description: Absolute path to the app or executable (e.g. /Applications/Amphetamine.app).

statusIconKind.description: How the menu-bar / tray icon visibility is controlled for one host. Platform-owned kinds carry a platform prefix, so a kind that does not belong to its host's platform is a validation error. 'manual' declares the desired state in config but the engine does not auto-provision it (no programmatic mechanism exists); the gap is surfaced via list/verify.

statusIconEntry.description: Menu-bar / tray icon visibility control for one host. Icon visibility is AND semantics: the icon shows only if the app-native show setting equals the desired state AND the OS allows it. We SET the native preference to the desired state; we never disable the native setting (unlike auto-start). Inverted keys (e.g. BetterDisplay hideMenuIcon) are expressed via iconVisibleValue/iconHiddenValue.

iconHiddenValue.description: Native value written when iconVisible is false. Typed per valueType.

iconVisible.description: Desired menu-bar / tray icon visibility (true = shown).

iconVisibleValue.description: Native value written when iconVisible is true. Typed per valueType.
